authorities.name: Tamil Nadu authority (select in grievance portal)

region.name: Tamil Nadu
region.scope: Full State of Tamil Nadu; excludes Puducherry Union Territory enclaves
region.source_license: Open Data Commons Open Database License (ODbL) 1.0
region.routing_note: State containment enables a neutral Tamil Nadu CM Helpline grievance handoff after the exact Greater Chennai Corporation check; it does not identify a local body, road owner, or complaint category.
limitations: The OpenStreetMap boundary is a routing aid, not a legal boundary record.
Puducherry Union Territory enclaves, including Puducherry and Karaikal, are outside this route.
The user must select and verify the responsible department or urban local body.
Municipal, PWD, panchayat, NHAI and other ownership is not inferred.
